content:
In #41740, @Monica Omar mentions that ofCompl, ofComplL and ofComplₗᵢ in the UniformSpace.Completion namespace aren't great names. I agree with that, partly because the name isn't written out and partly because the Compl abbreviation is also used for compliments, see e.g. LinearMap.ofIsCompl. Following the discussion #mathlib4 > naming convention: `UniformSpace.Completion` morphisms about naming the maps dealing with completions, I suggest we rename these toCompletion, toCompletionL and toCompletionₗᵢ respectively as the maps go from the space to its completion. What do you think?

docs: ofCompl
I think toCompletion, toCompletionL, and toCompletionₗᵢ makes sense to me
See my comment in the other thread: #mathlib4 > naming convention: `UniformSpace.Completion` morphisms @ 💬
